$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFAI (AIP France, chart dated 2022-08-11): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Nangis Les Loges

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

preferredQfuReason: preferred QFU 52, in order to limit noise pollution
notes: Simultaneous use of paved and unpaved RWY 05/23 prohibited.
RWY pattern landmarks: presence of visual cues materializing axis of final approaches RWY 05 and 23 (red and white checkerboard).
LDG QFU 232°, turn base leg EAST of "Le Sceau" then line up in long final 23 to overfly the checkerboard (leaving the farm on the Left side).
LDG QFU 052°, turn base leg overhead settling tanks of the sugar factory then line up in long final 05 to overfly the checkerboard (leaving the water tower on the Right side).
RWY circuit training below 800 ft AAL: only for training flights with instructor on board; height 300 ft AAL MNM.
Hot Spot: special attention to ground circulation on TWY Alpha: pay attention to proximity of parking areas on part of TWY Alpha parallel to the RWY.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
Pilots are required a close attention when operating grass RWY after severe rain falls.
Half turn prohibited on paved RWY and grass RWY.
Preferred QFU 052° in order to limit noise pollution.
As far as possible, respect published AD circuit.
ULM: Air traffic: only at NW of AD in the area noticed on the map.
Entrances and exits of area by NW.; Ground traffic: Double WEST TWY to use and clear the ULM RWY.
Use limited to pilots authorized by the chief pilot of ACMDMV or ACAM ACB.
